categories.main_business_segments: Lida Holdings Limited primarily engages in the design, manufacturing, and sales of air compressors, welding machines, and electric tools. The company focuses on piston, screw, and scroll type air compressors, with a significant emphasis on energy-efficient and environmentally friendly screw compressors. It also develops specialized products such as oil-free screw blowers, vacuum pumps, and refrigeration series compressors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including permanent magnet variable frequency screw compressors, high-speed centrifugal magnetic levitation blowers, and low-pressure air-cooled screw compressors. It emphasizes in-house R&D for key components like screw main engines to reduce costs and improve quality. Production methods include mature processes in metalworking, painting, assembly, and testing, with ongoing automation to enhance efficiency and reduce labor costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lida serves a broad industrial customer base including pharmaceutical, food processing, mining, chemical, electronics, power, construction, automotive, steel, furniture, and machinery manufacturing sectors. Its products are used in automation production lines, pneumatic tools, and various industrial applications requiring compressed air. The company’s main market is China, with growing sales in other regions, particularly Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing facilities in Fujian and Jiangxi provinces. It has subsidiaries in the British Virgin Islands, Hong Kong, and the Cayman Islands for holding and investment purposes. Sales are predominantly in China (over 67% of revenue in 2024), with other markets accounting for approximately 33%. The company is expanding its presence in Asian markets and maintains a global outlook.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lida operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembling air compressors and related electromechanical products. It sources raw materials such as steel, copper, aluminum, and motors from upstream suppliers and sells finished products to downstream industrial users and distributors. The company is increasing vertical integration by developing and producing key components like screw main engines internally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in energy-efficient, high-performance, and environmentally friendly air compressors, including permanent magnet variable frequency screw compressors and oil-free blowers. It aims to enhance product differentiation through innovation in noise reduction, efficiency, and automation compatibility. Lida plans to establish a dedicated R&D center, expand its product portfolio, and accelerate the development of high-power screw main engines and vacuum pumps to meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Lida generates revenue primarily through the sale of air compressors and related electromechanical products. Its revenue streams include direct product sales to industrial customers and distributors. The company also derives income from after-sales services, technical support, and strategic partnerships with dealers. Investment income from subsidiaries contributes to consolidated earnings but is secondary to core product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a fragmented and highly competitive air compressor market dominated by international leaders like Atlas Copco and Ingersoll Rand in the high-end segment. Lida positions itself as a leading domestic manufacturer with a focus on mid-to-high-end screw compressors, emphasizing product quality, energy efficiency, and customized solutions. It differentiates through strong R&D, mature production technology, and a comprehensive product lineup, aiming to expand market share amid intense competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Lida reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.63 billion, a 28% decline from NT$5.05 billion in 2023, with net profit of NT$137.8 million and earnings per share of NT$1.19. The company has experienced revenue fluctuations due to market conditions but maintains a stable equity base of over NT$6.17 billion. It invests around 4-6% of revenue annually in R&D and is focused on long-term growth through product innovation and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lida emphasizes high-quality, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly air compressors tailored to diverse industrial applications. Its products offer superior performance, reliability, and noise reduction, supported by strong after-sales service and technical support. The company leverages nearly 30 years of manufacturing expertise and continuous R&D to provide differentiated solutions that meet stringent customer requirements and comply with national energy efficiency standards, positioning itself as a trusted brand in the Chinese and global markets.
